content: Cloudflare Realtime TURN (docs fetched 2026-10-09, generate-credentials updated 2026-09-25): create key POST /accounts/{id}/calls/turn_keys {name} -> result {uid,key(64ch bearer, only returned at create),name,created,modified}; list/get omit key; needs Calls Write. Mint: POST https://rtc.live.cloudflare.com/v1/turn/keys/{uid}/credentials/generate-ice-servers Bearer key {ttl} -> 201 {iceServers:[{urls:[stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478]},{urls:[turn 3478 udp, turn 443 udp, turn 3478 tcp, turn 80 tcp, turns 5349 tcp, turns 443 tcp],username,credential}]}; port 53 URL may appear and is blocked by browsers (filter). Max credential TTL 48h; refresh via setConfiguration. Revoke POST .../credentials/{username}/revoke -> 204. Pricing $0.05/GB egress to client, 1000 GB/mo free shared with SFU; STUN free. Relay addrs IPv4 only; no TCP relaying; private peer IPs denied. Up to 1000 keys/account. customIdentifier shown on /credentials/generate.
